column1: # Connected negotiated-compression command I/O source evidence.

column5: The existing production PacketIoReader and PacketIoWriter now have a server consumer: handshake-selected none/zlib/zstd mode and zstd level feed sequence-zero command reads, sequence-one response writes, and flush/reset semantics around Connection dispatch. BufferedReadConn/net.Conn ownership, dynamic config, deadlines, byte metrics, terror logging, mysql.ErrBadConn conversion, and mutable in-place buffers remain external.
